theme: Guard Recovery and State Portability Release

shots.title: Bump @slope-dev/slope and bundled Codex plugin for the guard recovery and state portability release
shots.notes: Used scripts/version-bump.mjs to move the root package and bundled Codex plugin manifest to 1.58.0; the built CLI reports @slope-dev/slope v1.58.0.

shots.title: Run release validation, publish, verify npm, and close linked issue references
shots.notes: Release validation is green for PR #508: build, full test suite, typecheck, docs manifest, map check, npm publish dry-run, and GitHub CI all passed. Actual npm publication is deferred until the PR merges and GitHub release v1.58.0 triggers trusted publishing.

conditions.description: S144 release validation exposed #516 and #517 before closeout; both were raised, triaged, fixed, validated, and added to PR #508 before the release-readiness gate completed.
Trusted publishing is a post-merge GitHub release path, so npm latest remains 1.57.3 until PR #508 merges and v1.58.0 is released.

training.description: Release scorecards should distinguish release readiness from registry publication.
training.outcome: S144 records npm publish dry-run and CI as healthy while leaving npm latest verification for the trusted-publishing follow-up after merge.

training.description: Release-gate failures should become focused SLOPE issues before the train proceeds.
training.outcome: #516 and #517 were raised, triaged into S143.97 and S143.98, fixed, and included in the closing PR before S144 resumed.

nutrition.description: `corepack pnpm test` passed: 232 test files passed, 1 skipped; 3630 tests passed, 25 skipped.
`node dist/cli/index.js map --check`, `docs generate --pretty`, `docs check`, and `roadmap validate` passed with only standing historical roadmap warnings.
`npm.cmd publish --dry-run --access public` passed for @slope-dev/slope@1.58.0 without npm auto-correction warnings.
GitHub CI for PR #508 head fda04aacc73f17ed9b87065c3442314de8750e8f completed successfully.
`npm view @slope-dev/slope version --registry https://registry.npmjs.org` still returns 1.57.3; publish verification remains pending until merge and GitHub release v1.58.0.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: Disciplined, with the release gate doing real work instead of just rubber-stamping the train.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: Do not mark a release sprint fully published until npm latest advances and an installed-package smoke test passes.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: The final release gate found two legitimate SLOPE issues after the version bump, and both were small enough to repair before closeout.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: PR #508 can move from release-ready to published by merging, creating GitHub release v1.58.0, watching trusted publishing, and verifying npm latest.

bunker_locations: Release scorecards should wait for registry verification before claiming publish success.
Full-suite release gates can expose Windows timing hazards that focused tests miss.
npm publish dry-run warnings can indicate source metadata drift even when the command exits 0.
Trusted-publishing release trains need a clear handoff from PR readiness to post-merge release execution.
yardage_book_updates: Version bump path remains `node scripts/version-bump.mjs <version>`, updating package.json and templates/codex/plugins/slope/.codex-plugin/plugin.json together.
For v1.58.0, direct npm publish was not run; use the GitHub release trusted-publishing workflow after PR #508 merges.
Release readiness checks now include a clean `npm.cmd publish --dry-run --access public` with no npm package metadata auto-correction warnings.
Open SLOPE issues #516 and #517 are included in PR #508 close references alongside the earlier recovery issues.
